entries.desc: 在已构建源码后运行 host 打包命令会生成当前平台单文件 Koala 可执行程序。

evidence.command: npm run package:desktop:host && npm run package:desktop:release
evidence.note: After the B-c600:F-001 fix, host packaging rebuilt dist/desktop/koala-macos-arm64 and release packaging rebuilt macos-x64, macos-arm64, linux-x64, and win-x64 executables.

entries.desc: dist/desktop 目录可重复生成，旧产物或缺目录不会导致命令失败。

evidence.note: Reran host packaging with existing dist/desktop artifacts present; command rebuilt packages and overwrote the host binary without failing.

entries.desc: 打包入口必须是完整 bootstrap，不能退化成 packages/main/dist/cli.js 的 core-only CLI。

evidence.note: The packaged binary was executed directly; smoke checked core help, aux_doc_list help, and packaged verify_codex, proving the artifact uses the full bootstrap rather than core-only packages/main/dist/cli.js.

entries.desc: smoke 脚本会直接运行生成的二进制并验证 `status --help` 成功输出 Koala 帮助。

evidence.note: Verifier now executes the packaged binary under an isolated PATH; it checked core help, aux_doc_list help, packaged verify_codex, and printed packaged executable smoke passed.

entries.desc: 当二进制尚未生成时，smoke 脚本给出明确的先运行 package 命令提示，而不是误报通过。

evidence.note: Negative smoke intentionally exits non-zero with Desktop Koala binary is missing and the recovery hint to run npm run package:desktop:host.

entries.desc: 若二进制启动失败、缺少 aux_doc_list 或输出 bootstrap 错误，smoke 脚本必须非零退出。

evidence.command: env -i HOME=$HOME TMPDIR=/tmp PATH=/usr/bin:/bin dist/desktop/koala-macos-arm64 verify_codex && npm run test:codex-assets
evidence.note: Packaged verify_codex passes without global koala or Node shims in PATH; global fallback heartbeat is a non-hard packaged-runtime warning and codex asset regression coverage passes.

entries.desc: README 记录 host 打包、host smoke、三平台 release 输出路径和桌面端携带方式。

evidence.note: README contains the desktop packaging section, host package command, host smoke command, release command, and artifact path.

entries.desc: README 明确 host smoke 与 cross-platform release targets 的区别，避免把环境限制误认为代码失败。

evidence.command: rg -n "host binary|Release packaging for macOS, Linux, and Windows x64 targets" README.md
evidence.note: README distinguishes the host binary path from the multi-target release command so local environment limits are not confused with code failure.

entries.desc: README 必须说明 Vercel pkg 5.8.1 已废弃，不把它包装成长期最终方案。

evidence.command: rg -n "upstream Vercel project is archived|pkg 5\.8\.1|Node SEA|actively maintained `pkg` fork" README.md
evidence.note: README explicitly labels Vercel pkg as an early distribution shortcut, states the project is archived and 5.8.1 was its last release, and points to future migration options.
